answer_as_filed: Trinity Hospital Holding Company is Disproportionate Share Hospital, part of the Trinity Health System located in Steubenville, Ohio. We are located in a federally designated Health Professional Shortage Area (HPSA). Trinity Hospital provides care to a service area of just over 200,000 individuals. Despite operating at a significant loss, Trinity provides over $17 million in net community benefits including health improvement services, professional education, as well as financial assistance to uninsured or under insured patients. The 340B program helps offset these costs. The program supports our Outpatient Infusion Center, which provides comprehensive cancer care, chemotherapy and non-oncology infusion services in the patient’s home community. It also helps fund a clinical pharmacist that works in patient care areas to improve medication outcomes.
